content:
Christine Wong: Follow-up from the status draft — do we mark this as **Streaming degraded** or **API partial outage**? Current draft has “API Degraded Performance” + “Streaming Degraded Performance”. Feels redundant and might confuse folks.

Rafael Mendes: +1. We need to be consistent w/ taxonomy. What are we seeing on non-streaming routes?

Aisha Bello: Metrics snapshot (us-east only):
- `streaming_disconnect_rate` spiked from baseline ~0.3% -> 6–9% (p95) starting ~16:41 UTC
- `http_5xx_rate{route=/v1/chat/completions}` steady at ~0.12% (no correlated spike)
- `latency_p95{non_streaming}` steady (no material regression)
- `latency_p95{streaming}` looks “fine” but sessions terminate early

Aisha Bello: Also support for `stream=true` requests: retry succeeds but customers see partial outputs / broken UX.

Miles Thornton: From logs, it’s mostly SSE connections getting closed by edge after idle periods. Here’s one of the common signatures:
```log
level=warn svc=api-gateway region=us-east req_id=01J1ZK... msg="upstream closed" route=/v1/chat/completions stream=true err="context canceled" duration_ms=180234
level=info svc=stream-aggregator region=us-east req_id=01J1ZK... msg="client disconnected" bytes_sent=48291 tokens_sent=913
```

Tomáš Novák: If non-streaming is fine, I’d avoid “API partial outage”. Customers interpret that as ALL requests failing.

Owen Phillips: From support side: 3 tickets in last 20 min are all “streaming cuts off mid-response”. None complaining about non-streaming or embeddings.

Christine Wong: That’s consistent w/ SUP-18421 type feedback (“status says API degraded but it was streaming-only”). We should not repeat that mistake.

Rafael Mendes: Agree. For status components, we have a Streaming component specifically so we can localize.

Sean Gallagher: +1. Only mark API Gateway / Hosted API if we have broad 5xx/latency, 429s, or auth issues. Otherwise keep it scoped.

Miles Thornton: There is a *small* bump in `request_error_rate` on the gateway but it’s almost entirely `client_disconnected` on streaming. We can include in write-up if needed, but I don’t think it warrants “API partial outage”.

Aisha Bello: Here’s the breakdown:
```text
errors_by_category (us-east, last 15m)
- client_disconnected: 91.4%
- upstream_timeout: 4.2%
- http_5xx: 2.1%
- other: 2.3%
```

Christine Wong: So decision: mark **Streaming — Degraded Performance** (us-east). Keep **API — Operational**.

Rafael Mendes: Yes. Also do we need a regional component callout? Are we using “Hosted API (us-east)” yet or still global?

Christine Wong: Status page config still has global components + the Streaming component (no region subcomponents live yet). But we can say “primarily impacting us-east” in the text.

Tomáš Novák: Please add explicit customer guidance: if you can, set `stream=false` as workaround; otherwise retry w/ backoff. Also mention region pinning for Dedicated customers if relevant.

Owen Phillips: +1, and phrase it as “workaround available” so support can point customers to it.

Miles Thornton: Root cause still TBD, but likely keepalive / idle timeout mismatch. I’d avoid saying “edge provider” unless we’re sure.

Sean Gallagher: Use uncertainty language: “We believe…” / “We’re investigating…” and commit next update time.

incident-bot: Reminder: status updates require next update time. Current incident state: IDENTIFIED. (owner: @Christine Wong)

Christine Wong: Proposed status update text (IDENTIFIED):
- Component: Streaming (Degraded Performance)
- Message: “We’re investigating elevated streaming disconnects affecting some `stream=true` responses, primarily in us-east. Non-streaming requests are operating normally. Workaround: set `stream=false` or retry with exponential backoff. Next update in 30 minutes.”

Rafael Mendes: Looks good. Minor tweak: “elevated disconnects” -> “unexpected early termination of streaming responses” (clearer).

Aisha Bello: +1. Also maybe include that partial outputs may occur.

Christine Wong: Updated:
“...unexpected early termination of streaming responses (partial outputs).”

Sean Gallagher: Ship it. Decision recorded: **Streaming degraded only**, do not mark API partial outage unless 5xx/latency broadly impacted.

Christine Wong: Publishing now.

incident-bot: Draft status update published to status page (pending approval: none). Components: Streaming. Next update: 17:25 UTC.

Tomáš Novák: Can we capture this as a runbook example later? This is exactly the “streaming-only failure” scenario.

Christine Wong: Yep, will drop a note in ENG-4829 once we’re out of the incident.
